description: Variable Life (VL) category reclassified to 'Other' in ILEC data; associated with A/E elevation to 1.017 in 2018 observation year
ACA (Affordable Care Act) full implementation; may have introduced selection effects on individual life insurance as health insurance access changed
ILEC data collection period begins (2012); AG 38 reserve regulations may affect term product mix
US all-cause mortality improvement slowdown compared to prior decade; opioid epidemic contributed to excess deaths in ages 25-54
SOA MP-2014/2015/2016 improvement scale updates progressively reduced assumed future mortality improvement rates
Final observation year in training data (2019); COVID-19 pandemic effects are outside training scope — model predictions beyond 2019 should be treated with caution
